service.description: Whether the current user may see a request and what part the user has in it: found, visible (get#RecordLinkInfo with checkOnly), the user's current roles, isRaiser (filed it or its Reporter), isAssignee, isWatcher (the Watcher role or a RecordFollower row) and isParty. need: check answers without an error, view adds "not available" when it is not found or not visible.

The rows of the Requests list: the user's slice (see above) in one list, narrowed by the find, sorted and paged, with the count of each list (over the slice, without the find). The lists: all (open: not Completed or Cancelled, the default), raised (open, filed by the user or the user its Reporter), assigned (open, the user its Assignee), watching (open, the user a Watcher or a follower) and closed (Completed or Cancelled, the latest first). A status in the find takes the place of the list's open or closed. Each row: id, name, type, status (label and color), priority, customer, assignee, the request date and when it was last updated.
New request: a request filed by the user (mantle.request.RequestServices.create#Request), submitted or kept as a draft, with its type, priority, customer, description and the response wanted by.

return.message: CASE_DUE_DATE: This request is a support case: its due date comes from its service level; leave it empty

service.description: What RequestDetail shows of a request the user may see (found false, or visible false: "not available"): the request with its type, status, priority, customer, assignee, reporter and dates, what its status-bar shows (the stages Draft, Submitted, Reviewed, In Progress and Completed, and allowedStatusIds, the transitions the user may take: Submit for a draft the user raised, Cancel for an open request the user raised), the parties, the tasks linked by RequestWorkEffort (decorated as task rows; a maintenance work order only for a user Maintenance admits to it, impl-maintenance P4), the other records it is on (WikiPageRequest and RequestRecord; a record the user may not see is left out) and the actions that apply.

The requester's status changes: Submit a draft one raised (ReqDraft to ReqSubmitted) and Cancel an open request one raised (to ReqCancelled), through mantle.request.RequestServices.update#Request. Review, progress and completion are Customer Service's.

return.message: Only a draft you raised can be submitted here
Only an open request you raised can be cancelled here
Commons does not set a request to ${toStatusId}

service.description: Edit a draft request the user raised: its name, type, priority, customer, description and the response wanted by (mantle.request.RequestServices.update#Request).

return.message: Only a draft you raised can be edited here

service.description: Reassign: the request's assignee (the user) hands it to another person (mantle.request.RequestServices replace#RequestParty, role Assignee).

${assignToPartyId} is not someone a request can be assigned to

service.description: A comment on a request the user may see (mantle.request.RequestServices.add#RequestComment: a Comment communication event from the user joined by RequestCommEvent), which Chatter shows as a note.
A task on the request for the user (ironstone.commons.QuickCreateServices.create#Task with the request as its record: RequestWorkEffort), by one of the request's parties while it is open.

return.message: Only the request's people may add a task to it

service.description: Puts the request on a record that is not already a task of it (RequestDetail): a work effort through RequestWorkEffort, a wiki page through WikiPageRequest, any other record through RequestRecord (mantle.request.RequestServices.link#RequestRecord). record is "entity|id" as the picker answers, or recordEntityName and recordId. One of the request's people, while it is open.

Takes the request off a record (mantle.request.RequestServices.unlink#RequestRecord: the own join and any RequestRecord). The record stays. One of the request's people, while it is open. A task is taken off through this too when the record is that work effort.
